description: Hub gene pathway co-occurrence ranking / Hub 基因通路共现度排序 | USE WHEN: the user has candidate genes and wants to rank them by how often they appear in known pathways (a rough hub screen) | ALIASES: hub基因, 枢纽基因, 通路共现, 度中心性, hub gene, degree, pathway co-occurrence, MSigDB, centrality | RETURNS: 按 degree 排序的 top/all、n_input/n_found、每个基因命中的通路名；**degree 是「本地 MSigDB 基因集出现次数」，不是 PPI 互作度**（返回体写明）…

gene_list.description: 基因符号数组（HGNC 官方大写符号，如 ["TP53","EGFR"]）。top_n 默认 10；符号写错会得到空结果而不是报错，务必用标准符号。
